plugins.name: secret-scanner
plugins.description: Detects hardcoded secrets, credentials, and API keys in source code and git history using gitleaks rules. Runs entirely in a sandboxed WASM module; workspace bytes never leave the IDE.

plugins.name: static-analysis
plugins.description: AST-aware static analysis for dead code elimination and structural security issues using semgrep and tree-sitter WASM modules.

plugins.name: supply-chain-audit
plugins.description: Audits third-party dependencies for known vulnerabilities, license violations, and typosquatting. Runs offline against a local advisory database.
